description: Fetch a paginated list of OTP transactions for a date range. Each transaction includes message_id, timestamp, phone_number, channel, country, cost, status, and the originating client IP. Date range cannot exceed 31 days. Defaults: last 7 days, page 1, 10 per page. Requires the API_REPORTING entitlement (Business or Enterprise plan). Use this to: audit recent activity, build internal dashboards, reconcile billing, or debug delivery issues across many recipients.

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC). If omitted, defaults to today. The range start_date..end_date cannot exceed 31 days.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1. Default 1.

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (UTC). If omitted, defaults to 7 days before today. The range start_date..end_date cannot exceed 31 days.

name: get_usage_report

message.description: Present when the endpoint has no data for the range.

total_count.description: Total transactions matching the date range.

total_pages.description: Number of pages at the requested per_page.

transactions.description: Transaction rows for the page. May be empty or absent when there is no data.

message_type.description: Whether this was an OTP send or a verification.

status.description: Transaction status, e.g. delivered, read, failed.NoBalance.

title: Get usage report
